title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the full launch of Spyglass, making our powerful new tool available to everyone.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Enjoy greater control over your content with new file management capabilities, enabling you to effortlessly upload, remove, download, and adjust how your files and images are displayed within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our vision and progress on a dedicated public roadmap page, highlighting recently delivered features, upcoming developments, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and beautifully integrated into your workspace.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly improved the real-time collaboration experience in the editor, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on all relevant shared items, making teamwork smoother and more productive.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive international language support to serve our growing global community.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with maximum control and transparency to collaboratively shape the future of our project.

title: Powerful Graph View: Filter, Connect, and Discover
summary: Transform your knowledge exploration with an upgraded Graph View featuring intuitive filters for tags, time, and shared items, making it an indispensable tool for discovery.

title: Precision Search and Custom Knowledge Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with new powerful filtering and sorting options, allowing you to instantly save your refined searches as custom Compendiums.

title: Flexible Note Previews
summary: Organize your ideas and information with versatile new display modes that offer interactive previews of linked content, enhancing how you structure your thoughts.

title: Empower Your Teams with Noeko's New Self-Hosted and Paid Plans
summary: Noeko is launching versatile self-hosting options and introducing new paid plans, giving individuals and enterprises greater control over their data and features.

title: Elevate Your Look with More Themes
summary: Get ready for a fresh new look as we refine existing themes and launch an exciting array of new visual styles for you to choose from.

title: Smart Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized welcome as your app's greetings will now accurately reflect the current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management & Direct Item Actions
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by performing essential actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, or viewing details directly from any tag's list, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock New Content Types
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly import and interact with a wider variety of content, from YouTube videos and websites to text documents, centralizing all your essential knowledge.
